title: AGENTS.md
text: Source lives R/: read_streams.R – reader family. read_stream(path) dispatches extension (stripping .gz) read_gpx_stream(), read_tcx_stream(), read_fit_stream(). reads file returns stream tibble (one row per track point) columns drawn timestamp, lat, lng, altitude, heartrate, cadence, temp, dev_dist, velocity_smooth, watts, grade_smooth. drop_empty_cols() removes column entirely NA. derive_columns.R – addcols_* transforms: addcols_time(), addcols_distance() (adds distance, plus dist_diff device distance dev_dist present), addcols_speed() (smoothed), addcols_speed_naive(). Pure tibble → tibble; documented one family via @describeIn.

title: AGENTS.md
text: reader also extracts activity-level (per-point) metadata pass attaches single flat attribute, attr(d, "activity_metadata"), built internal new_stream_meta(). flat named list fixed field set: format, source, sport, sub_sport, title, start_time, n_sessions, total_distance, total_timer_time, total_calories. Design rules: Flat – nested values – converts one-row table via tibble::as_tibble(). source offers several values one field (e.g. multisport FIT file), collapsed one slash-joined string ("swimming/cycling"). Format inconsistencies normalized (TCX Biking vs FIT cycling, case, etc.); extract -, resolve downstream ever needed. recordless FIT file (workout definition, activity) reads genuine empty 0 x 0 stream, still carrying metadata attribute.

title: Add derived columns to a stream tibble — derive_columns
text: addcols_time(): Add cumulative elapsed time (seconds first point). addcols_distance(): Add cumulative distance (metres) geodesic point--point segments. device-reported dev_dist column present (TCX/FIT), also add dist_diff = dev_dist - distance QA. addcols_speed(): Add smoothed instantaneous speed (m/s), plus speed_kmh pace (min/km). Speed centred moving average point--point diff(distance) / diff(time) window points either side. addcols_speed_naive(): Add naive average speed_ms (m/s) cumulative distance / time, plus speed_kmh pace (min/km). Unsmoothed; running average start, instantaneous rate. addcols_latlng_offset(): Add lat_offset lng_offset (degrees): lat/lng relative first point . Absolute coordinates dwarf within-activity variation, offsets make movement legible eyeballing stream.

title: Read a Strava export track file into a stream tibble — read_stream
text: read_gpx_stream(): Read GPX file. Garmin TrackPointExtension fields (hr, cad, atemp) read via namespace-stripped XPath, GDAL extension flag required. read_tcx_stream(): Read TCX file. Strava's TCX exports carry leading whitespace <?xml> declaration, file read text trimmed parsing. read_fit_stream(): Read FIT file (requires FITfileR package). records() may return several tibbles file multiple record definitions; bound. Record fields vary files, safe getter returns NA absent fields. file record messages (e.g. workout definition) yields empty (0 x 0) stream.
